publisher: Samordna opptak (Norwegian Universities and Colleges Admission Service)
verifiedBy: Read against the source page, 2026-09-22. The page states it covers the 2026 intake; 2027 dates are not yet published.
claim: Applications open 1 February and close 15 April at 23:59, with documentation due the same day. Education finished during the spring may be uploaded until 1 July, which is also the last date to change the order of your choices.
excerpt: 1. februar Opent for søking. […] 15. april Ordinær søknadsfrist — 15. april kl. 23.59 er siste frist for å søkje eller legge til fleire studieønske i søknaden din. […] Viss du har søknadsfrist 15. april kl. 23.59, må du laste opp avslutta utdanning og annan dokumentasjon seinast same dato. Utdanning og praksis som du fullfører i vår kan du laste opp fram til 1. juli. […] 1. juli Omprioriteringsfrist. […] Når du får tilbod i hovudopptaket, fell lågare prioriterte studieønske bort.
interpretation: The 1 July date is the problem and it is worth stating exactly. It is the last day to upload documentation for education finished during the spring — and the IB publishes results on 6 July. An IB candidate finishing in May 2027 therefore cannot document their Diploma within the window as published. How Samordna opptak handles that is NOT established here and must not be guessed at: it is the single question to settle before relying on a Norwegian application.
